output.summary: The Arts gap is mostly SlotBook, not general deprioritisation. SlotBook tickets were routed to P4 under RR-17, and they sat a median 17 days before a technician acted. They account for about 70% of the 6-day gap. Matched non-SlotBook tickets resolve within 0.3 days of other faculties' tickets. The rest of the gap is Lindqvist's Tuesday/Thursday on-site coverage, which Education shares. Arts duplicate and trivial ticket rates are normal. The P4 acknowledgement gave requesters no notice of best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told about RR-17 is unestablished: the only record is a 30-minute meeting with no notes. The SSO link to the SlotBook rise is unproven. Agree SlotBook's support status in writing, fix the acknowledgement and report monthly. Do not make all Arts tickets best-effort, create an Arts desk, or force a CampusBook move before a fit assessment.
